login_email.notes: Email/phone field on dashboard.doku.com — use .first() since type may vary by browser context

login_submit.notes: Login submit button (MASUK). Use JS click: document.querySelector('button[type="submit"]')?.click() to bypass overlay

cookie_accept.notes: Cookie banner — optional, appears on first visit

otp_input.notes: OTP modal has 6 INDIVIDUAL input boxes. Use otpInputs.nth(i) for each digit. Auto-submits after last digit — no submit button click needed.

session_timeout_modal_button.notes: Session timeout/end modal Masuk button — intercepted by overlay, must JS click: document.querySelectorAll('button.d-btn-primary').forEach(b => b.click())

gross_volume_iframe.notes: Inside the DOKU summary iframe (src: /rr/homepage?uniq_id=...). Access via page.frameLocator('iframe:not([width="0"])').first(). Format: 'IDR 157.902.336'

next_payout_iframe.notes: Usually blank — treat as 0 if empty or timeout. Access via frameLocator.

kirimdoku_login_email.notes: KirimDOKU email field — role-based selector required

kirimdoku_login_submit.notes: KirimDOKU submit is <input id='start' type='submit' value='Sign in'>. Must use JS click: document.getElementById('start')?.click(). Displayed as 'SIGN IN' (CSS text-transform)

kirimdoku_credit_left.notes: Credit Left value on kirimdoku.com/v2/dashboard. Format: '3.636.160.238,010000 IDR'

_notes.doku_iframe_src: The DOKU summary iframe src is /rr/homepage?uniq_id=<timestamp>. The GTM iframe (hidden, width=0) appears first in DOM — use 'iframe:not([width="0"])' to skip it.
_notes.kirimdoku_session_conflict: KirimDOKU has a 2-minute session lock. If login returns 'currently logged in', navigate directly to /v2/dashboard. Server lock expires within ~2 minutes.
_notes.otp_boxes: 6 individual input.input-otp boxes. Auto-submits after filling the 6th digit.
_notes.number_format: dashboard.doku.com uses dot thousands (IDR 157.902.336); kirimdoku.com uses dot thousands + comma decimal (3.636.160.238,010000 IDR). Apply parseIndonesianNumber() to both.
